comment: SHK1, step 2: what is carried over from SHK2 (the player's own shk_sh2.bin) into SH1 REV00, and how. Only addresses and the replacement bytes we write; the code and art are copied at build time by tools/make_image.py. Approach (2026-10-22): SH1's own player object stays (every SH1 object talks to it), and Knuckles' own code is added to it - glide, glide landing/sliding, wall climb, ledge climb, glide start, his landing reset and his animation routine (SHK2's object $01 is at $315328, a SH2 player; the $30E006-$310000 range in the first draft was other objects). SH2 engine calls go to the SH1 routine with the same code shape, or to a shim in k1.s.

glide: Knuckles' air mode with $21 set: glide speed, glide states 1-5 (glide, fall, slide, climb, ledge climb), glide animation
glidestart: end of JumpHeight: A/B/C pressed while jumping starts the glide (Super Knuckles branch disabled until step 7)
glidecol: level collision while gliding: wall hit / landing flags
reset: ResetOnFloor: radii, status bits, $21 cleared, Knuckles-only animations stopped
animate: Animate + animation scripts (frames in Knuckles' own mapping order)

dead: Super Knuckles transformation check (skipped by the patch at $31655A)

0x316378: LevelBound: SH1 Sonic_LevelBound (same shape; S1 camera limits)
0x318F38: floor, two sensors (S1 Sonic_Floor's floor call)
0x318FF6: floor at d2+x radius / d3: no S1 entry point, shim
0x3192E6: ceiling at d2-x radius / d3: shim
0x319208: right wall at d2 / d3+x radius: shim
0x3193D2: left wall at d2 / d3-x radius: shim

0xFFF7AC: glide collision flags (bit 1 airborne, bit 5 wall); free S1 RAM
0xFFF66C: S2 look-up delay counter: cleared only
0xFFFE2E: S1 speed shoes (written by our patch at $317086)

patches.why: skip the two S2 collision-table selects ($F796 is S1's collision index pointer)
no spin dust object in S1 ($FFD100 is another object's slot)
move_lock is $3E in S1 ($2E in S2)
running animation speed with speed shoes: S1 keeps them in $FFFE2E, S2 in status_secondary bit 7

animations.comment: SH1 animation ID (what S1 objects set) -> SHK2 Knuckles script. IDs $1F-$24 are Knuckles' own (glide etc.) and keep their SHK2 number.

hud.comment: Lives icon: SHK2's Nemesis art (Knuckles' face and K.T.E, same 12-tile layout as SH1's) replaces SH1's, whose only PLC entry is at $1D660.
hud.sign_comment: Signpost: SHK2 overlays the face with its own 24 tiles ($33AF4C, two 3x4 columns like SH1's face, tiles $20-$37 of S1's signpost art $3A53E, loaded only by the PLC entry at $1D978).
hud.mon_comment: 1-up monitor: Knuckles' face (the lives icon's first 2x2 tiles, as SHK2's 1-up shows his lives icon) over Sonic's face, tiles $1C-$1F of SH1's monitor art $39658 (only PLC entry at $1D674).
hud.texts_comment: Text frames in SH1's title-card font (it has K and U): act results frame 0 'SH HAS' (Obj3A, table $CBD8, pointer at $C5D0) and special-stage results frame 8 'SH GOT THEM ALL' -> 'KNUCKLES GOT ALL' (the whole line must fit sprite x offsets -128..127) (Obj7E, table $CC9A, pointer at $C80A); each table is copied with the new frame.

title.comment: SHK2-style title on SH1's: the emblem/logo plane drawn 4 rows lower, SHK2's title Knuckles (mapping frames 4 + 5/6/7 of $3109B8, tiles $1B3-$23A of the title sprite art) in TitleSonic's place, SHK2's 'KNUCKLES THE ECHIDNA IN' banner (31-piece frame at $310B78; its art: $33E93E at tile $3FE, $33EF7A at $488) as a fifth Obj0F frame. no palette change: Knuckles is drawn with the nearest colours of SH1's title line 1 (Sonic's blues excepted); the banner's SHK2 line 3 is SH1's title line 0 except black (slot 1 -> 15).

palette.comment: By default no SH1 palette entry changes: Knuckles' art (and his lives icon, signpost and 1-up faces) is drawn with the nearest colours SH1's line 0 already has, Sonic's blues excepted. The settings option KNUCKLES COLOURS (ROM word toggle at $95FFE, read live by K_ColSync) switches to K_ART2, his own colours in slots 2-5 of these palettes, written into the palette buffers at run time (PALTAB); water versions shifted the way S1 shifts Sonic's. Slots 14/15 (SHK2 $0AE/$08E) stay on the nearest S1 colour: S1 badniks and planes use both.
